assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated small rarity filter icon for a fantasy woodland collectible card game UI.
Primary request: a single miniature portrait playing card back, ornate but very readable as a 40 pixel tall icon. muted sage green enamel and brushed silver frame, pale silver central leaf emblem.
Subject: one upright rectangular card, 5:7 width to height ratio, softly rounded corners, substantial beveled metal frame, restrained flowing botanical corner engraving and a single large embossed leaf in a simple diamond at center. Card back has a dark enamel field. Soft hand painted high quality fantasy game inventory art, coherent warm woodland aesthetic.
Composition/framing: straight on frontal view, vertical, no tilt, no perspective, centered in a square image and filling 85% of its height. Full silhouette visible with transparent margin.
Lighting: gentle top left highlights, small crisp rim glow, subtle depth, no large cast shadow.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Constraints: exactly one card, no characters, no letters, no numbers, no typography, no text, no watermark, no surrounding objects, no sparkles outside the silhouette. No wide glow. Keep the silhouette clean and the central symbol bold.
